note: Numpad notation, facing right: 6 = forward, 4 = back, 2 = down, 8 = up, 236 = quarter circle forward. Craft Gauge: 4 bars, kept between rounds. Overdrive: more damage and Craft Gauge until the Burst gauge runs out.

sections.title: Normals
moves: chains A > B > C; 5C fires both guns
2B is a quick shot, 2C fires twice
Crescent Launcher: launches; any normal cancels into it; jump (8) on hit to chase

sections.title: Specials
moves: the only rekka: shot; follow up with 6 + A/B/C (turned shot), then 6 + A/B/C again (low finisher, knockdown). Shots cancel into a dash (66) on hit or block
straight beam across the whole screen, no follow-ups
rising crescent kick (B: two kicks, invincible start: her anti-air)
1 bar. Invincible: two kicks send them very high; if both hit, she rides her board up and slams them into the floor (otherwise a downward shot)
1 bar. Straight shots, then the big beam: it blasts them into a wall bounce

she hops into the air (A: back, B: forward; in the air she hops off her flux board and goes high), kicks a red fragment that drifts slowly to the floor, splits in two (one lobs, one skids) and explodes only at the end of its path; touching them on the way applies hitstun. Cancels into j.236 after the kick. Built for oki. Starts up in 22 / 24 frames on the ground, 18 / 21 in the air
1 bar. 15 frames on the ground, 11 in the air. Faster, harder-hitting fragments and a bigger blast

powered dash on her board straight through the opponent: A travels a short distance (10f startup, 2 active), B medium (12f / 3), C long (16f / 4). The strike only comes out if the opponent is in hitstun; on block or anything else she just passes through. Once per jump. After the actives it cancels into air normals, air 214, and the double jump. 12f landing recovery; whiff an air normal (j.A) before landing to cut it

sections.title: Supers
moves: huge sustained beam across the screen, invincible
board rush (passes through projectiles); on hit a flame prison floats them up and she circles it on her board, firing into it, then lands, flips her hair, and it explodes

sections.title: System
moves: full Burst gauge, works in hitstun
On the ground: dash forward, or back dash with back held. In the air: air dash forward, or back with back held
